# Playbooks: Workspaces, projects and people (+ project kickoff) (`lpm-workspace-admin`)

Load a section only when `lpm-workspace-admin.md` tells you to.

## § flow-kickoff

## Flow: project kickoff
Load when: decision row 3 (kickoff)

### Preconditions
1. LPM API key with the full profile, or a custom key holding every tool below. The flow mixes portfolio tools (project, team, repository link), planning tools (cycle, milestone, label), requirements tools (baseline, requirement) and the sensitive `add_team_member`; no other preset covers it. Connector → core rule 2.
2. The user named: project name, key (3–6 uppercase letters), workspace, first-cycle dates, milestone outcomes with target dates. Optional: team, governance-role people, routing-profile terms, label names, repository URL, first-baseline name. Ask once for every missing required item; never invent an optional one.
3. Each block is tagged with its owner skill: [workspace-admin], [requirements-scope] (`lpm-requirements-scope.md`), [plan-work] (`lpm-plan-work.md`), [code-index] (`lpm-code-index.md`). Follow that skill's rules for its block. Finish a block's re-read before starting the next one; never run writes of two blocks in one turn.
4. Order (help article `como-comecar-um-projeto`): governance roles → baseline and requirements → activities. Every create here is not idempotent: after a timeout, re-list before any retry.

### Steps
1. [workspace-admin] `list_projects`(workspaceId, includeArchived=true) → same `key` or `name` → STOP (§ Stop and ask row 1).
2. [workspace-admin] Team, only when the user named one: `list_teams`() → reuse the same `name`, else `create_team`(name, description) [A] → keep `teamId` after "ID: ". You become its owner member.
3. [workspace-admin] Team members (skip without a team): reused team → callerUserId (SKILL.md §3) is its `owner`/`admin` in `list_team_members`(teamId), else ask the team owner. `list_workspace_members`(workspaceId) → `userId`, `userEmail`; `get_user`(userId) → `email`; `add_team_member`(teamId, userId, userEmail, role="member", or `owner`/`admin` when the user asked) [C].
4. [workspace-admin] [C] Show "create_project(name, key, workspaceId, teamId, description)"; on "yes" `create_project`(name, key, workspaceId, teamId, description) [C] → keep `projectId` after "ID: ". Timeout → step 1 before any retry.
5. [workspace-admin] Resolve each named person, with or without a team: `list_workspace_members`(workspaceId) → `userId` whose `userEmail` (or `get_user` → `displayName`) matches; 0 or 2+ → ask "What is the LPM user id of <person>?". Then `get_project`(projectId) → `update_project`(projectId, governanceAssignments=[{role, userId}] for `project-owner`, `product-owner`, `delivery-lead`, routingProfile=<all nine arrays, see `lpm-workspace-admin.refs.md` § routing-profile>) [C]. Send full objects. You create the project, so the kickoff order naming these people or terms is the owner instruction; quote it.
6. [requirements-scope] First baseline, only on the owner's authorization [O]: `create_requirement_baseline`(projectId, name=<the user's name, default "Escopo inicial" shown in the [O] request>, version="1.0", isCurrent=false) [O] → keep `baselineId` after "ID: ".
7. [requirements-scope] Seed, per requirement the user gave: `create_requirement`(projectId, baselineId, title, description, type, status="pending") [C]; `type` ∈ `functional`, `non-functional`, `interface`, `business`, `technical`.
8. [requirements-scope] Make it current [O]: `update_requirement_baseline`(projectId, baselineId, isCurrent=true) [O]. Send only `isCurrent`.
9. [plan-work] `create_cycle`(projectId, name="<startDate> to <endDate>", startDate, endDate, status="active" when startDate ≤ today, else "upcoming") [A] → keep `cycleId` after "ID: ". Check `endDate` > `startDate` yourself.
10. [plan-work] Per milestone: `create_milestone`(projectId, name=<outcome>, targetDate) [A] → keep the id.
11. [plan-work] Only when the user named labels: `list_labels`() → reuse labels equal after lowercase/trim. Only when none fits: `create_label`(name, color="#RRGGBB") [C], saying labels are universal (every workspace sees them).
12. [code-index] Optional: `create_project_repository_link`(projectId, repositoryUrl="https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>") [C] → keep `id`; `scan_project_repository_readonly`(projectId, repositoryLinkId=<id>) [A]. Code search needs a workspace link: `lpm-code-index.md`.
13. Activities are created afterwards with `lpm-plan-work.md`, not in this flow.

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| duplicate key or name in step 1 | "A project <key> already exists (<id>). Use it?" |
| steps 6 and 8 without the owner's authorization in this conversation | skip steps 6–8; report "first baseline pending owner authorization"; offer the decision request (see `lpm-workspace-admin.refs.md` § authority-and-owner-decisions (#decision-request)) |
| "Material baseline publication requires an approved change set" in step 8 (only if a baseline already existed) | STOP → `lpm-requirements-scope.md` (change set first) |
| governance-role people or routing terms not given | skip that field in step 5; list it under Pending |
| no repository URL | skip step 12 |
| no labels named | skip step 11; never invent a label taxonomy |
| a new label would duplicate an existing meaning | reuse the existing label; ask before creating |

### Verify (legacy exit criteria)
| Criterion | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| project exists | `get_project`(projectId) | `id` and `key` match; `archived == false` |
| ownership exists | `get_project` + `list_team_members`(teamId) | `governanceAssignments` holds the named roles; a team used has ≥1 `owner`/`admin` |
| team members added | `list_team_members`(teamId) | every userId added in step 3 is listed |
| requirements seeded | `list_requirements`(projectId, baselineId) | the number of items equals the number seeded in step 7 |
| repository linked | step 12 scan result | `status == completed` (or step 12 skipped) |
| cycle exists | `get_cycle`(cycleId) | one cycle, `status` as sent (`active` or `upcoming`), dates as sent |
| milestones exist | `list_milestones`(projectId) | every planned milestone with its `targetDate` |
| label taxonomy not duplicated | `list_labels`() | each label created in step 11 has no twin equal after lowercase/trim (or step 11 skipped) |
| execution can start without ambiguity | `get_project_execution_context`(projectId) | an `active` step 9 cycle is in `planning.activeCycles` (an `upcoming` one is checked by the cycle row); `scope.currentBaseline` set (or the named pending item); `planning.openMilestones` lists the milestones |

### Report fields
Scope, project id/key, team, roles, baseline id (or pending), cycle, milestones, labels reused/created, repository link/scan, Pending, Next.


## § flow-people

## Flow: workspace members and teams
Load when: decision row 10

### Preconditions
1. LPM API key: full or custom for member add/remove and team delete; portfolio for team create/rename. Connector → core rule 2 (`list_workspace_members` is the only people tool on a connector).
2. Workspace members: `list_workspaces` → `access.canManage == true`, or the memberId is you (leave). Teams: callerUserId (SKILL.md §3: `list_api_keys` → `userId`; else ask the user) equals `get_team` → `ownerId`, or has `owner`/`admin` in `list_team_members`; delete: `ownerId` only. The server does not check `update_team` or `delete_team`: you are the guard. callerUserId unknown → ask; never compare against a guessed id.
3. Roles and least privilege: see `lpm-workspace-admin.refs.md` § roles. Effects of removals: see `lpm-workspace-admin.refs.md` § destructive-ops. No tool lists all users or finds one by email: ask for the LPM user id.

### Steps
#### A. Workspace members (row 10)
1. `list_workspace_members`(workspaceId) → keep `id`, `userId`, `userEmail`, `role`. Add and the person is listed → report the role and STOP.
2. Add: follow SKILL.md P2 (userId from the user; `get_user`(userId) → keep `email`, `displayName`; role `member` or `viewer`, `owner`/`admin` only when the workspace owner asked). Remove: target is `get_workspace`(workspaceId) → `ownerId`, or the last owner/admin → STOP: "Ownership transfer is not supported through MCP."
3. Show the call with all arguments (write userEmail=(from get_user), never the address) and its effect (add: access to every workspace project at once, no notification sent); on "yes": `add_workspace_member`(workspaceId, userId, userEmail=get_user `email`, role) [C] / `remove_workspace_member`(workspaceId, memberId) [C]. Role change = remove, then add, under one confirmation naming both calls. Never change your own role (callerUserId): the add fails once your manage right is gone. Add fails after the remove → STOP and report "<person> removed; re-add failed: <error>" to the workspace owner.
4. Not idempotent: after an error or timeout re-run step 1 before any retry ("User is already a workspace member" = already added). Verify: `list_workspace_members`(workspaceId) → the person has the requested `role`, or is absent; a role change → one row for the person, with the new `role`.
#### B. Teams (row 10)
5. `list_teams`() → keep `id`, `name`, `ownerId`. Create: same `name` → reuse; else `create_team`(name, description) [A] → keep `teamId` after "ID: "; timeout → step 5 before any retry.
6. Rename: `get_team`(teamId) → callerUserId owns or admins it (Precondition 2) → show the call; on "yes" `update_team`(teamId, name and/or description only) [C]. Never send `ownerId`.
7. Add: `list_team_members`(teamId) → not listed; `get_user`(userId) → `email`; show the call; on "yes" `add_team_member`(teamId, userId, userEmail, role="member") [C]; tell the user it sends a "Team invitation" notice.
8. Remove: memberId from `list_team_members`(teamId), never the team `ownerId`; show the call; on "yes" `remove_team_member`(teamId, memberId) [C].
9. Delete (callerUserId == team `ownerId` only): show `get_team`(teamId), `list_team_members`(teamId), `list_projects`(teamId); ask "Delete team <name>? No undo; member records stay orphaned and <N> projects keep its teamId. (yes/no)"; on "yes" `delete_team`(teamId) [C].
10. Verify: `list_teams`() / `list_team_members`(teamId) → the new name, member or role is present; removed or deleted ids are absent (`delete_team` reports success even for an unknown id).

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| role `owner` or `admin` not asked by the workspace or team owner | "Owner/admin gives full management rights. Did the owner ask for it? Otherwise I use member." |
| removing the workspace owner, the last owner/admin or the team owner | STOP: "Ownership transfer is not supported through MCP." |
| you are not the team owner/admin, or callerUserId is unknown | ask the team owner / "What is your LPM user id?" |
| you are asked to change your own workspace role | STOP: "Ask another workspace owner/admin to change your role." |
| `add_workspace_member` fails after the remove | STOP: report "<person> removed; re-add failed: <error>" to the workspace owner |
| user id unknown | "What is the LPM user id of <person>?" |

### Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| workspace member add / remove / role change | `list_workspace_members` | `role` as requested, or the person is absent |
| team create / update / delete; team member | `list_teams` / `list_team_members` | name and `role` as requested; removed or deleted ids absent |

### Report fields
Scope (workspace / team), Done (people and roles before → after), Evidence (re-read), Pending (member add: "tell <displayName> directly: LPM sends no notification"), Next (exactly one action, never "none"). Name people by `displayName` + userId; never paste an email or `hourlyRate`. Write in the user's language.


## § flow-project-admin

## Flow: create, change, archive or unarchive a workspace or project
Load when: decision rows 4, 5, 6 or 8

### Preconditions
1. Reads (`list_workspaces`, `get_workspace`, `list_projects`, `get_project`) work on a connector. Writes need an LPM API key: portfolio profile for creates and settings; full or custom for archive and unarchive. A write on a connector → core rule 2.
2. Workspace updates: `list_workspaces` → `access.canManage == true`. Project updates, archive, unarchive: `get_project` → `access.canManage == true`. `create_project`: the workspace is in your `list_workspaces` result. `create_workspace`: nothing extra.
3. `governanceAssignments`, `routingProfile`, `workspaceId` or `teamId`: only on an instruction of the `project-owner` (`get_project` → `governanceAssignments`) or the workspace owner (`get_workspace` → `ownerId`) naming the change in this conversation. A `name` or `description` change needs only the user's yes.
4. IDs come from SKILL.md §3 Inputs. Creates are not idempotent: after a timeout, re-list before any retry (core rule 5).

### Steps
#### A. Create a workspace or a project (row 4)
1. Workspace: `list_workspaces`() → same `name` → ask "Use <id>?" and STOP. Else show the call; on "yes" `create_workspace`(name, description; `slug` only when the user gave one) [C] → keep `workspaceId` after "ID: ". Report under Pending: "AI is on with default budgets: the owner reviews it with `lpm-ai-cost.md`".
2. Project: `list_projects`(workspaceId, includeArchived=true) → same `key` or `name` → ask "A project <key> already exists (<id>). Use it?" and STOP. Else show "create_project(name, key, workspaceId, teamId, description)": key = 3–6 uppercase letters, name per `lpm-workspace-admin.refs.md` § naming-conventions, teamId only when the user named a team. Continue only on "yes".
3. `create_project`(name, key, workspaceId, teamId, description) [C] → keep `projectId` after "ID: ". Timeout → step 2 before any retry. Report next steps: governance roles (B), first baseline (`lpm-requirements-scope.md`), activities (`lpm-plan-work.md`).
4. Verify: `get_workspace`(workspaceId) → `name` matches; `get_project`(projectId) → `key`, `workspaceId` match and `archived == false`.
#### B. Project settings, governance roles, routing profile, move (row 5)
5. `get_project`(projectId) → keep `access.canManage`, `workspaceId`, `teamId`, `governanceAssignments`, `routingProfile`. `canManage == false` → STOP: "Only a project manager can change this: <project-owner>." Roles, routing or move without the owner instruction of Precondition 3 → § Stop and ask row 2.
6. Patch = only the changed fields; never send `hourlyRate`, `archived`, `ownerId`, `key` or fields outside the schema. `governanceAssignments` replaces the list: copy step 5, change only the named roles (`project-owner`, `product-owner`, `delivery-lead`), one per role, userId from SKILL.md §3 (see `lpm-workspace-admin.refs.md` § roles).
7. `routingProfile` replaces the object: copy step 5, send all nine arrays (see `lpm-workspace-admin.refs.md` § routing-profile); omitted arrays become `[]`, `null` clears it. No `workspaceId` → STOP "The project needs a workspace first." Unowned gap: add the exact string from `list_unowned_domains_or_capabilities`(workspaceId) to `domains` or `ownedCapabilities`. Move: `workspaceId` from `list_workspaces`, `teamId` from `list_teams`.
8. Show each changed field as before → after; continue only on "yes". Then `update_project`(projectId, changed fields) [C].
9. Verify: `get_project`(projectId) → every changed field equals the patch and kept roles are present; move → `routingProfile` re-read and shown (see `lpm-workspace-admin.refs.md` § routing-profile); gap: `list_unowned_domains_or_capabilities`(workspaceId) → the gap `id` is absent.
#### C. Archive or unarchive a project (row 6; see `lpm-workspace-admin.refs.md` § destructive-ops)
10. `get_project`(projectId) → keep `name`, `key`, `archived`, `access.canManage`. `access.canManage == false` → STOP: "Only a project manager can change this: <project-owner>." `archived` already equals the request → report "nothing to do" and STOP.
11. Archive: ask "Archive <name> (<key>)? It leaves the project lists; data is kept; unarchive restores it. (yes/no)" → `archive_project`(projectId) [C]. Unarchive: ask "Restore <name> (<key>) to the active lists? (yes/no)" → `unarchive_project`(projectId) [C].
12. After unarchive: `list_requirement_baselines`(projectId) → no `isCurrent == true` → report "unbaselined" → `lpm-requirements-scope.md`; `list_issues`(projectId, status="in-progress", limitCount=100), then status="todo" → report open work.
13. Verify: `get_project`(projectId) → `archived` equals the request.
#### D. Rename, archive or reactivate a workspace (rows 6 and 8)
14. `get_workspace`(workspaceId) → keep `name`, `status`; `list_workspaces`() → `access.canManage == false` → STOP. Delete asked (row 8) → say "No MCP tool deletes a workspace" and offer archive. `status="archived"` → ask "Archive workspace <name>? ChatGPT/Claude connectors bound to it start failing with access denied. (yes/no)"; other changes → show the call; on "yes" `update_workspace`(workspaceId, changed fields; `status` `active`|`archived`) [C].
15. Verify: `get_workspace`(workspaceId) → every sent field (`name`, `status`) equals the request.

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| same workspace `name` or project `key`/`name` exists | "A project <key> already exists (<id>). Use it?" / "Use <id>?" |
| `governanceAssignments`, `routingProfile`, `workspaceId` or `teamId` change without an instruction of the `project-owner` or workspace owner naming it in this conversation | send the decision request (see `lpm-workspace-admin.refs.md` § authority-and-owner-decisions (#decision-request)) to that owner; STOP. With the instruction: quote it in the report |
| people or values for settings not named | ask; never invent a userId, key or routing term |
| `access.canManage == false` | "Only a project manager can change this: <project-owner>." |
| change the project `key` | "Changing a project key is not supported through MCP." STOP |

### Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| create workspace / project | `get_workspace` / `get_project` | `name`, `key`, `workspaceId` match; `archived == false` |
| settings, roles, routing profile, move | `get_project` | every changed field equals the patch; kept roles present; after a move `routingProfile` re-read |
| archive / unarchive | `get_project` | `archived` equals the request |
| workspace update | `get_workspace` | `name`, `status` equal the request |

### Report fields
Scope (workspace, project key + id), Done (fields before → after), Evidence (re-read; owner instruction quoted for roles, routing or move), Pending, Next.
